Horizons Arabic Level 1

Arabic letters and first words, brought to life through listening, pictures and writing.

What’s included

Explore 28 Arabic letters through 560 words, 560 example sentences and 56 short stories. Listen to the Arabic audio, connect words with pictures, practise letter shapes and revisit lessons at your own pace. Designed for guided learning at home or in the classroom; no child account is required.

Languages and compatibility

Version 1.2.0 for Windows 10/11 (64-bit). The interface and guides support 32 languages. Lesson meanings are available in Arabic, English, Turkish, French and Spanish. An optional male voice is planned as a free update; no release date has been set.

Licence and availability

The planned family licence covers up to three registered devices. Sales and email-code activation will open after release checks are complete. Learning progress stays on your device. Contact support before moving a licence or reinstalling Windows.

All fixes and updates for this level are free for existing buyers. Future levels are separate products.
